snippet.title: VOID REAVER - Official Demo Update Trailer #roguelike #indiegame #inventorymanagement #cyberpunk
snippet.description:
Organize. Optimize. Obliterate. 

Welcome to a sci-fi bullet heaven where your inventory is your ultimate weapon. 

Arrange your backpack to create explosive synergies with 300+ items to unlock, dedicated skill trees and a high-octane soundtrack to blast through unrelenting waves of enemies !

Play and Wishlist on Steam : https://store.steampowered.com/app/4096910/Void_Reaver/
